summary: Records ADR 0025: the effects layer's grounds are written for this library (no gradient library; gradflow and MagicPattern were a benchmark only), aurora is retired, every shader ends in a static triangular dither, and a ground keeps its copy legible with a quiet zone of its exact base instead of a per-pixel contrast guard (amends ADR 0022, rules 5 and 6). Research and measurements: docs/webgl-gradients.md.
